_what: Values docs/NITROGEN.md and docs/GRUNDLAGET.md read out of documents rather than computes. Each carries the exact phrase it sits in, and scripts/nitrogen.py and scripts/pages/grundlaget.py refuse to build unless that phrase occurs in the pinned text of the source (data/derived/pins/<source>.txt; sources in data/manual/claims.d/nitrogen.json). Values that cannot be pinned are not kept here: the page quotes its own committed text for them, and counts them.
